title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：praise　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 praise 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the teacher ① gave the praise that no pupil in the classroom would have noted, and he said the giving was the whole of the term. The ② praise, meaning the word itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; praise, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ lesson of praise in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ praise at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Praise, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the teacher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the praise was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the word. The ⑥ praise, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; praise, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both word and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ praise had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ praise of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of noting; praise, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ praise I remember is the praise noted in the notebook, which closed in 1991 and is still noted as the quietest in the classroom. ⑩ Praise, my mother said in 1993, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all praise, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like word. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 表扬；称赞（指教室里每一课旁边的那一课）
B. n. 表扬；称赞（指那句表扬本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：give the praise 给予这一句表扬
D. n. 表扬；称赞（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 表扬之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的表扬之事）
F. n. 表扬；称赞（指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一句）
G. n. 表扬、荣誉（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 荣誉（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave the praise that no pupil in the classroom would have noted
The praise, meaning the word itself and not the ruler
Every lesson of praise in that classroom
the praise at the far blackboard
the praise was the whole of the matter
the praise had become a line in a notebook
The praise of the whole thing

answers.why: give the praise 意为“给予这一句表扬”，1984 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯记下的一句表扬做了一遍。
praise 意为“表扬；称赞”，指那句表扬本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
praise 意为“表扬；称赞”，指教室里每一课旁边的那一课，每一课旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
praise 意为“表扬；称赞”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
praise 意为“表扬、荣誉”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这句荣誉就是那件事的全部。
praise 意为“荣誉”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那句表扬，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
praise 意为“表扬；称赞”，指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一句，到 1989 年这一句成了笔记簿里的一行。
praise 意为“表扬之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的表扬之事是一处教室和三个学期的记下。
praise 意为“表扬；称赞”，我记得的是笔记簿里记下过的那一句，1991 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一句。
praise 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，表扬是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的表扬。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

那句表扬，指的是那句表扬本身而不是短短的尺子，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（praise）
